method: AWS Price List bulk API EU region index (current version 20260826161754) for standard on-demand text-token meters; official Bedrock pricing page (Anthropic 'Geo and In-region Cross-region Inference' table resolved via the awsstatic meteredUnitMaps feed for EU (Frankfurt)), model cards, and regional-availability pages for current models absent from the EU bulk feed. Flex, priority, batch, cache, legacy/EOL, gated non-GA models (Claude Mythos 5 / Mythos Preview, OpenAI Daybreak Red/Blue) and non-text modalities are excluded. EU rows use the actual regional or EU Geo cross-region price, not a lower unrelated US or Global route: for Claude, Geo/in-region profiles (eu.anthropic.*) are billed 1.1x the Global profile (global.anthropic.*), which matches Anthropic's direct-API list price. Claude Sonnet 5 stores the active launch-promotion price through 2026-08-31; its standard price (Geo $3.30/$16.50, Global $3/$15) begins 2026-09-01. Sources: https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing/ , https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/cross-region-inference.html , https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-cards.html , https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonBedrock/current/eu-central-1/index.json
